facets.match: Read the complete cached checklist and both walkthroughs, all 18 mapped actors and 28 supporting entries, including four empty alias bodies distinguished from implemented canonical handlers. Precursor chain: Telin 20472 Worn Note ->Faelin 20446 Ring ->Giz 20447 Coin and hostile Reaver 20190 ->Telin 20448 Worn Coin ->Althele 20450 Amulet ->Sionae 20451 Frayed Amulet ->Nuien same 20451 ->Teloa consumes it and signals the ceremony. Althele preserves delayed speeches/signals, Corruptor 15153 plus two Reavers 15150, and cleanup; Tome 20452 ->Earth Note 18959. Ella's note hand-in supplies instructions, and the documented two-tasks dialogue gives Bowl 17860. Enabled 8842 combines one each 20464/20465/20466/20467 ->Mixture 20473 while retaining the bowl. Alrik supplies Pot 20457; Farios ->List 20458; Nora ->Provisions 20459; Farios ->Receipt 20474; Alrik ->Pattern 18960. Kinlo Jade Reaver 5664 ->Clay 20455. Merdan Rose 12774 ->Painting 20475; human skeleton ->Locket 20476 and despawn; Niera ->Powder 20456. Enabled 9178 combines Pattern+Clay+Powder in pottery station 21 ->Bowl 20460. Ella Mixture 20473+Bowl 20460 ->Stone 20462. Venril remains Firefly Globe 10295 ->Spirit 102123; Resurrection 15392 ->hostile triggered Venril 102126, whose loot has Green Stone 20461. Foloal 20462+20461 ->Warm Stone 20468; Ella ->Elaborate Scimitar 20440. Withered treant Ancient Rock 20688+Clean Lakewater 20689+Tundra 20690 ->Heart 20695 and despawn; Yeka ->Antonica 20698 and despawn. Unicorn Kedge Crystals 20691+Seavines 20692+Heartwood 20693 ->Horn 20694; Silox ->Faydwer 20697 and despawn. Dolgin returns Essence 20696 and spawns Faydedar 96073; Nekexin Essence 20696+Pure Lakewater 20685+Bark 20686+Pod 20687 ->Kunark 20699 and despawn. Xanuusus three spirits 20697/20698/20699+Scimitar 20440 ->Nature Walkers Scimitar 20490. All 13 required killed-NPC loot categories have static candidates. Actual Lake Rathe trigger 51149 is named corrupted_aquagoblin, level 36, but its own loot table explicitly supplies 20689; do not confuse the different name with a missing item. Source and raw loot/spawn/recipe hashes are separately retained.
facets.discrepancy: Abbreviated conversions omit Foloal's documented answers branch naming Venril, Alrik's artifacts conversation and fuller delivery instructions, and Ella's later route/Xanuusus instructions. Nekexin's sole spawn point 17803/group 11394/NPC 93043 uses 640 seconds rather than the documented two hours. Dolgin's imported 21600-second timer plus 2160 variance disagrees with the page's internally conflicting 12/14-hour claims; no choice between those claims is made. The tainted hooks unconditionally create corrupted variants, whereas the general walkthrough describes uncertain outcomes; specific probabilities are not established. P 99's Corruptor 10-second idle expiry differs from local five minutes, retained under the documented encounter adaptation rather than mislabeled as a match.
facets.proposal: Approved p99-af-druid-progression-dialogue restores the exact supported progression instructions in Alrik, Foloal and both Ella aliases, retaining all exchanges and shared Ranger branches. Eight normalized fixture scenarios cover documented prompts, rewards, partial/wrong/surplus returns and unchanged bag protocol. Approved p99-af-nekexin-respawn changes only row 17803 respawntime to 7200; group membership is exactly NPC 93043 with 100% weight. Two baseline recipe expectations 8842/9178 are in supporting-recipe-expectations.json. Capture/structural tests are not live encounter or crafting proof.
facets.adaptation: Existing encounter and eligibility adaptations are preserved. Shared raid lifecycle remains outside this content-only correction; the retained Corruptor timer is not presented as a P99 match.
facets.unknown: Required forage acquisition of Rose 12774 and plants 20464–20467 is not auditable from this export: no forage table/runtime source is supplied. Natural rare/placeholder progression, exact probabilities, corrupted expiry and actor stats/name equivalence, unquantified XP/faction values, Farios's unverified 3 copper, Dolgin's conflicting respawn, movement, shared encounter state and actual settlement remain open. The full primary exchange graph is now reviewed, but a natural unseeded connected playthrough, item-effect execution, complete live acquisition and rendering are not certified.

p99_evidence_lines.text: [[File:first_p99_epic_druid_deano.jpg|thumb|200px|Project99 Blue Server First {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}} - Deano]]
[[File:SaidinEpic.jpg|thumb|200px|Project99 Red Server First {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}} - Saidin]]
[[File:EklorinEpic.png|thumb|200px|Project99 Green Server First {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}} - Eklorin]]
| [[Burning Woods]]
| [[Druid]]
== Rewards ==
<ul><li> {{:Elaborate Scimitar}}
• {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}}
** The [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] summons and so is (nearly?) impossible for a [[Druid]] to solo.  Bring a [[Necromancer]] friend, as he is easy to fear kite.
** The [[Corrupted Seahorse]] summons and so is very difficult for a [[Druid]] to solo. Bring (at least) a [[Torpor]] [[Shaman]] or small group.
** The  [[Corrupted Brownie]] summons and so is difficult for a [[Druid]] to solo.
* Must kill [[a black reaver]] (or buy a [[Jade Reaver]])
* Must kill [[Venril Sathir]] (the version spawned by [[Venril Sathirs remains]]), which requires a small raid, or buy a multi-quested [[Pulsing Green Stone]]
* Must kill [[Ulump Pujluk]] (requires a small group)
* Must kill [[Faydedar]]
* '''Acquire a [[Shiny Tin Bowl]]''' ( '''Warning : You must be ready to face Dark Elfs, by starting East Karana part, Nuien trigger Teloa, who trigger Dark Elfs''' )
:* Speak with [[Telin Darkforest]] in [[Burning Wood]] and say "I will take action" to receive a [[Worn note]].
:* Spawn [[Faelin Bloodbriar]] in [[Greater Faydark]] and give her the Worn Note to receive [[Faelin`s Ring]].
:* Give [[Giz X`Tin]] in [[Kithicor Forest]] Faelin`s Ring to receive a [[Dark Metal Coin]].
:* Give [[Telin Darkforest]] in [[Burning Wood]] the Dark Metal Coin to receive [[Worn Dark Metal Coin]].
:* Give [[Althele]] in [[East Karana]] the Worn Dark Metal Coin to receive [[Braided Grass Amulet]].
:* Give [[Sionae]] (-2300, -930 in [[East Karana]]) the Braided Grass Amulet. (Amulet is returned)
:* Give [[Nuien]] (-3650, 300 in [[East Karana]]) the Braided Grass Amulet. (Amulet is returned)

:* '''CAUTION, THIS STEP SPAWNS AN ENEMY YOU MUST INTERCEPT''': Give [[Teloa]] (-3800, -2860 in [[East Karana]]) the Braided Grass Amulet, spawning the [[Dark Elf Corruptor]] and two [[Dark Elf Reaver]] at (-700, -1450) '''Note: They run really fast when spawned, almost SoW fast'''
:* Kill the [[Dark Elf Corruptor]], loot [[Fleshbound Tome]].
:* Give [[Althele]] in [[East Karana]] the Fleshbound Tome to receive [[Earth Stained Note]].
:* Give [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]] the Earth Stained Note to receive a [[Shiny Tin Bowl]].
* '''Forage the [[Hardened Mixture]]'''
::* [[Chilled Tundra Root]] from [[Everfrost]].
::* [[Ripened Heartfruit]] from [[Greater Faydark]].
::* [[Speckled Molded Mushroom]] from [[Innothule Swamp]].
::* [[Sweetened Mudroot]] from [[Misty Thicket]].
:* Combine all four items in the [[Shiny Tin Bowl]] to make a [[Hardened Mixture]].
* '''Make a [[Runecrested Bowl]]'''
:* Acquire an [[Ancient Pattern]]
::* Speak with [[Alrik Farsight]] in [[Timorous Deep]] and say "I will take the artifact" to receive a [[Crushed Pot]].
::* Give [[Farios Elianos]] in [[Felwithe]] South the Crushed Pot to receive a [[Grocery List]].
::* Give [[Merchant Nora]] in [[Northern Felwithe]] the Grocery List to receive a [[Bag of Provisions]].
::* Give [[Farios Elianos]] the Bag of Provisions to receive a [[Receipt]].
::* Give [[Alrik Farsight]] in [[Timorous Deep]] the Receipt to receive an [[Ancient Pattern]].
:* Acquire some [[Platinum Speckled Powder]]
::* Forage a [[Rose of Firiona]] from [[Firiona Vie]].
::* Hail [[Merdan Fleetfoot]] in [[Surefall Glade]], ask him "Who is Niera?", then hand him the Rose of Firiona to receive a [[Wood Painting]].
::* Give [[a human skeleton]] in [[Frontier Mountains]] (behind the giant fort) the Wood Painting to receive a [[Silver Chained Locket]].
::* Give [[Niera Farbreeze]] in [[Surefall Glade]] the Silver Chained Locket to receive [[Platinum Speckled Powder]].
:* Acquire some [[Enchanted Clay]]
::* Kill [[a black reaver]] in [[City of Mist]], loot a [[Jade Reaver]].
::* Give [[Kinlo Strongarm]] in North Kaladim the Jade Reaver to receive [[Enchanted Clay]].
:* Combine the [[Ancient Pattern]], [[Platinum Speckled Powder]], and [[Enchanted Clay]] in a [[Pottery Wheel]] to create a [[Runecrested Bowl]].
* '''Trade Stones for an [[Elaborate Scimitar]]'''
:* Give the [[Hardened Mixture]] and [[Runecrested Bowl]] to [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]] to receive a [[Softly Glowing Stone]].
:* Create a [[Summoned: Firefly Globe]] (level 1 Druid spell, NO RENT, only castable at night: 7p - 4a).
:* Purchase Scroll of [[Resurrection]] (level 49 Cleric spell).
:* Give [[Venril Sathir Remains]] in [[Karnor's Castle]] the Summoned: Firefly Globe to spawn [[Spirit of Venril Sathir]].
:* Give [[Spirit of Venril Sathir]] in [[Karnor's Castle]] the Spell: Resurrection to spawn [[Venril Sathir]].
:* Slay [[Venril Sathir]] in Karnor's Castle and loot a [[Pulsing Green Stone]].
:* Give [[Foloal Stormforest]] in [[Firiona Vie]] the Pulsing Green Stone and Softly Glowing Stone to receive a [[Warmly Glowing Stone]].
:* Give [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]] the Warmly Glowing Stone to receive an [[Elaborate Scimitar]].
::* Kill [[corrupted wooly mammoth]] (level 30) in [[Everfrost Peaks]], loot a [[Chunk of Tundra]].
::* Kill [[corrupted shaman]] (level 40) in [[Lake Rathetear]], loot [[Clean Lakewater]].
::* Kill [[corrupted hill giant]] (level 40) in [[Rathe Mountains]], loot an [[Ancient Rock]].
::* Give [[Withered treant]] in [[Northern Karana]] the [[Chunk of Tundra]], [[Clean Lakewater]] and [[Ancient Rock]] to receive a [[Warm Pulsing Treant Heart]].
::* Give [[Yeka Ias]] in [[Southern Karana]] the Warm Pulsing Treant Heart to receive [[Cleansed Spirit of Antonica]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted Seahorse]] (level 53) in [[Kedge Keep]], loot [[Kedge Cave Crystals]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] (level 52) in [[Ocean of Tears]], loot [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted brownie]] (level 51) in [[Lesser Faydark]], loot [[Green Heartwood Branch]].
::* Give [[Pained Unicorn]] in [[Lesser Faydark]] the [[Kedge Cave Crystals]], [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]] and [[Green Heartwood Branch]] to receive [[Gleaming Unicorn Horn]].
::* Give [[Silox Azrix]] in [[Ak'Anon]] the Gleaming Unicorn Horn to receieve the [[Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer]].
::* Kill [[Ulump Pujluk]] (level 55) in [[Swamp of No Hope]], loot [[Froglok Essence]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted Gorilla]] (level 47) in [[Emerald Jungle]], loot [[Green Tree Bark]].
::* Kill the [[Corrupted barracuda]] (level 46) in [[Lake of Ill Omen]] and loot the [[Pure Lakewater]].
::* Give [[Dolgin Codslayer]] in [[Timorous Deep]] the Froglok Essence (he will hand it back and despawn - 14h respawn) to spawn [[Faydedar]].
::* Kill [[Faydedar]] in [[Timorous Deep]], loot [[Pod of Seawater]].
::* Give [[Nekexin Virulence]] in [[The Overthere]] the [[Froglok Essence]], [[Pod of Seawater]], [[Green Tree Bark]] and [[Pure Lakewater]] to receive [[Cleansed Spirit of Kunark]].
* '''Acquire a [[Nature Walkers Scimitar]]!'''
:* Give [[Xanuusus]] in [[North Karana]] the Elaborate Scimitar and three cleansed spirits to receive the '''[[Nature Walkers Scimitar]]'''.

It starts with {{NPC| Telin Darkforest}} (Level 55) in [[Burning Woods]]. He's hidden in a grove of thick trees near to the [[Skyfire]] zone and has been spotted at 3234, 2871. Use tracking to find him, and invis to get through the zone unharmed. Hail him.
==== Faction Issues ====

If Telin responds with "I can not trust you with such important information yet," changing into wolf form may raise your faction enough to start the quest. If he will not respond even with wolf form, you will need to work on your faction.  Specifically, if you have done any of the following:

Then you will most likely have faction issues to correct in order to complete the epic. Also, if you are a halfling or human worshipping Karana you may also have some faction work to do (no more than 20 stacks of Muffins, see below).

It's tedious, but it can be done.   ''As of 2017-07-12, I was able to receive the worn note in wolf form without any faction work. (55 Halfling Druid) (I just did the turn in on a 47 Halfling worshipping Karana with no faction work and not in wolf form - 11/28/2017)''

He will give you 'a worn note'. If he doesn't, then your faction may be too low. Faction can be built up fast by doing the "Muffin Quest" ([[Muffin for Pandos]]) in Freeport. Also, you must be of level 50 or higher before he will speak to you as well. [This may not be true - I was able to have him speak to me on my level 46 Woodelf druid. Does NOT work with a level 46 Halfling Druid. **Note: Was able to turn in 18 stacks of Muffins to get to Amiable and Telin gave me 'a worn note' on 46 Halfling Druid of Karana (I just did the turn in on a 47 Halfling worshipping Karana with no faction work and not in wolf form - 11/28/2017)]
*note: As a 47 halfling druid, went from apprehensive to amiable when in wolf form. Received the note. 7/8/22

*note: Level 44 halfing druid (Karana) initially apprehensive and no dialog.  In wolf form, amiable, but got the message "You are not yet powerful enough to complete this task..."  Likely requirements are level 46 and faction.

Next, [[Faelin Bloodbriar]] in [[Greater Faydark]]. She spawns around 1513, 561 or south-west of the [[Crushbone]] zone with a 7 minute respawn. She has an orc pawn placeholder, so kill every pawn you see to make her spawn. Once she spawns, make sure you have casted [[Spirit of the Wolf]] on yourself, because she runs constantly and won't stop when you hail her. Give her the note (and keep running after her) and you'll receive a ring. After giving her the note she despawns.
(While you do this step, make sure to forage; you may get a [[Ripened Heartfruit]] you will need in a later step.)

Go to [[Kithicor Forest]] and track [[Giz X`Tin]], a dark elf who will not attack you. He can be found on the path to [[Highpass Hold]], but is usually closer to the [[West Commons]] zone than [[Highpass Hold]]. Be very careful of the other dark elves in this zone. Give him the ring and he gives you a [[Dark Metal Coin]]. After you hand him the ring a level 50 [[Teir`Dal Reaver]] spawns and attacks you. He has tons of HP, backstabs, and summons; don't try to solo him. Have SoW on you so that you can run away. (4 hour repop on this mob, there is also a possibility that multiple Druids and Rangers can turn in back to back but it seems there is a very short time window to do so, plus the risk of the Teir`Dal Reavers is present with each turn in)

Go back to [[Telin Darkforest]], turn into wolf form if necessary, and give him the Coin. He will not accept the coin at apprehensive - he must be amiable. He will give it back to you as [[Worn Dark Metal Coin]] and tells you to find [[Althele]]. She is in [[East Karana]], just west of the barbarian fishing village, near the shore at -3658, -1593. Once you start this section, you begin a chain of events, so don't do it until you are ready to finish the job.
Give her the [[Worn Dark Metal Coin]] and receive a worn amulet.

Give this amulet to [[Sionae]] (-2300, -930) (She can be standing either on the East or West side of the farm located there, so check both sides), then to [[Nuien]] (-3650, 300 - Spawns near the gnolls, out of tracking range) and finally to [[Teloa]] (-3800, -2860 - Spawns near the waterfall). [[Teloa]] will say to follow her, but don't. Sionae, Nuien and Teloa will each run to join Althele. A [[Dark Elf Corruptor]] and two Darkelf Reavers (all around level 50) will spawn around (-700, -1450) (it will take a minute or two before they spawn after turning in to Teloa, there will be a zone message from the Corruptor when they do).  The trio will run south toward this gathering of druids and be summarily decimated and the corpses will poof.  '''Therefore you or your party must wait for them or intercept them before they get to there. If they poof, you must start from the beginning''' (it is suggested to stand near the farm where Sionae was located and just look north up the mountain to watch for them, invis and them run up next to them when you see them and Harmony off to the side to not aggro, then pull away the Corruptor). Also keep in mind these inkies are Shadow Knights, so don't be too close to their spawn point or you will be harm touched (To solo as a Druid in the 50s, Buff HP, MR, DR, FR, SoW, and Regen and Root Rot after peeling Corruptor away with Harmony).  If you do choose to engage all three, a charmed pet can be useful to absorb harm touches.  Most of the animals in the zone are lower lvl, but they're still useful for something.

If the Reavers kill the druids (which, again, won't happen), just wait one hour of real time (not EQ time) and [[Althele]] will spawn again. Give her the tome and she gives you an [[Earth Stained Note]]. She then despawns for one hour so if you are doing back to back fights for multiple druids, don't turn any books in until you have all got one. Bring the [[Earth Stained Note]] to [[Ella Foodcrafter]], a Halfling running around in [[Misty Thicket]]. Like Faelin, she constantly runs, so you have to chase her. Give her the [[Earth Stained Note]] and she will tell you that she needs a mixture. She will give you her mixing bowl. It is a Container so you need a free slot in the Inventory. She also mentions some kind of ancient bowl that she needs.
* A [[Chilled Tundra Root]] from [[Everfrost Peaks]]
* A [[Sweetened Mudroot]] from [[Misty Thicket]]
* A [[Speckled Molded Mushroom]] from [[Innothule Swamp]]
* A [[Ripened Heartfruit]] from [[Greater Faydark]]

Now go to the Chess Island in [[Timorous Deep]]. Take the Barrel Barge (boat) from the dock in Oasis of Marr , which will take you to Timorous Deep. Cast Egress to transport yourself to the Chess board island, or cast levitate on yourself to make the run. Use track to locate Alrik Farsight. He's at about -6500, 2000, but does wander. Egress is a level 52 Druid spell, and Succor is a level 57 group.

You say, "Hail, Alrik Farsight", "How do you make an ancient bowl?" and "I can take the artifact." He gives you a crushed pot and sends you to Felwithe. You will soon return here but, unfortunately, you can't bind on the island.

You must con amiable to him. If your faction is too low, you can build up faction fast with the "[[Bat Wings|Batwings Quest]]" in Felwithe South. [Please note, Farios Elianos conned kindly to my wood elf druid, but would not speak to her when hailed. This didn't affect the progress of the quest, as I was still able to turn in the crushed pot to receive the grocery list.]

Once Farios cons amiable and talks to you, give him the pot and you receive a grocery list. The dialogue with the NPCs for this segment is pretty funny. He will give you the receipt for the bowl if you do a job for him. Bring this grocery list to [[Merchant Nora]] in the Shop of All Halos in [Felwithe North]], which is near the cleric guild. She gives you in return a bag of Provisions. Bring it to Farios and he gives you the receipt for the ancient bowl. Head back to [[Alrik Farsight]] in [[Timorous Deep]]. He will give you an [[Ancient Pattern]] when you give him the receipt.
The pattern says that you have to combine it with a piece of enchanted clay and [[Platinum Speckled Powder]] in a pottery wheel. No skill in pottery is required.
[[Platinum Speckled Powder]] can be obtained through the following sub quest:

Forage a [[Rose of Firiona]] in [[Firiona Vie]] and give it to [[Merdan Fleetfoot]] in [[Surefall Glade]], a male ranger in the back of the zone, near the water. In return he will give you a [[Wood Painting]]. You may find it beneficial to bind your self in Surefall at this point to save time running back from [[Frontier Mountains]]. The Wood Painting that you get from Merdan has to be brought to the human skeleton (Level 40) lives in [[Frontier Mountains]]. It can be found at (-261, -574) behind the giant fort (along the outside of the fort's West wall).

Gate back to [[Surefall Glade]]. Give the locket to [[Niera Farbreeze]], a human female in banded armor, also near the water but close to the druid guild building. She will hand you the [[platinum speckled powder]].

[[Enchanted Clay]] can be obtained through [[Kinlo Strongarm]] in Kaladim's EverHot Forge. If you ask him "what mud" and "do it for me" he will tell you that he would like to have a colored axe for his service. He wants a [[Jade Reaver]] that can be found in the City of Mist off of [[a black reaver]] who is about level 52. This is not easy at all. The [[Jade Reaver]] is a rare drop and the Black Reavers are a real pain to take down. You will need at least one full group of 50+ players if not two, and one must be a rogue with high lock picking skills.

Hand Kinlo the axe and you get the enchanted clay. If you hunted dwarf citizens in Butcher, invis yourself and head to the forge. You are able to do a sneak turn-in from behind if Kinlo himself is KOS to you. The merchants, thankfully, are on a different faction table. Just go to the Everhot Forge and hand Kinlo a [[Jade Reaver]] to get the clay. Now combine the pattern, clay and powder in any pottery wheel to make the [[Runecrested Bowl]].

Go Back to [[Misty Thicket]] and hand [[Ella Foodcrafter]] the [[Hardened Mixture]] and the [[Runecrested Bowl]]. She will make for you a [[Softly glowing stone]] from it. Ella tells you to find one such as yourself. For the Druids this means to seek out [[Foloal Stormforest]] in [[Firiona Vie]].

Foloal is a half elf on the wall that circles the city of [[Firiona Vie]] at the north end. Ask her "are you one such as myself?", "what answers?" and "what about [[Venril Sathir]]?" She tells you to bring her the stone you already have from Ella and the gem that can be found on [[Venril Sathir]]. Kill him to get the [[Pulsing Green Stone]].

You can kill [[Venril Sathir]] in [[Karnor's Castle]], but why? Venril is a very tough shadow knight. He is only killed by the strongest guilds or big raids because he is level 55, hits for 300 FAST, has a 1000+ life suck spell and has three personal clerics that heal him whenever he gets hurt. This guy is extremely hard so you might want to be in a good raid guild to do this part.

Better thing to do is let some uber guild take him down. He gets killed for his loot all the time. His remains will spawn in 24 hours, or less. When you see [[Venril Sathir]] Remains on track, get your friends together, fast. The Remains will be indifferent to you and just stand there. Hail him and he will respond.

First, conjure a Firefly Globe. [[Dance of the Fireflies]] is a level 5 druid spell that you may not have even bought, but you'll need it for this. Hand him the globe. A new VS will spawn. Then give him the level 49 cleric [[Resurrection]] spell, which you can buy at any cleric guild. He will attack you. Step back and let your tanks take him out. Thankfully, this new VS is not as brutal as the original, but he's no cakewalk either.
The remains will drop two stones, called [[Pulsing Green Stone]]. You can use either stone.

Take the [[Softly glowing stone]] and [[Pulsing Green Stone]] to [[Foloal Stormforest]] a female half elf in [[Firiona Vie]]. She will give you a [[Warmly Glowing Stone]]. This is the time where the quest splits up into the Druid and the Ranger parts. Up to now, they've been identical.

The Druid's path leads back to [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]]. Give her the stone and you will get the [[Elaborate Scimitar]] (10/30 9 wis 10 mana 5 sv poison and disease). Now you have one of the four final pieces and a pretty good weapon in its own right.
She asks you to collect the Cleansed Spirits of Antonica, Faydwer and Kunark and hand them along with the scimitar to Xanuusus.

Go to [[Northern Karana]] and find a [[withered treant]]. It is at the far north end of NK, at the base of a mountain wall. It’s very close to Xanuusus, who gets the three Cleansed Spirits and the Scimitar when you are done. Hail him and ask him "What Sickness" and he will respond that he wants you to cleanse Antonica of its sickness. He means to kill three things.

The second monster is the [[Corrupted Shaman]], an aqua goblin. He is mid level 30 in Lake Rathe with side spawns on tops of the underwater tower. There is a female dark elf named Deep for the Cleric Epic Quest. Ignore her and she’ll ignore you. Do this in wolf form so the other goblins won't agro on you. Some people have chosen to fight under water, but if Enduring Breath wears off you could be in a heap of trouble. You are better off kiting the goblins at the top of the tower to the surface, especially since these gobs are clerics and cast some strong cleric spells. They can dish out a serious hurting, plus they can heal themselves. Kill the gobs at the top of the tower only, don’t bother with the ones around the base. Eventually a [[Tainted Aquagoblin]] will spawn. Kill the Corrupted and get a Clean Lakewater item. It looks like a globe of water. (Note that if you try to use the tower's inner corners to prevent water push back from mob hits to mitigate casting interrupts, the corners will auto-duck you)

The third one creature is the Corrupted Hill Giant in Rathe Mountains. You want to hunt in the HG area south of the hill with the Guard Tower in Rathe, where Cyclops can also be found. The same process applies here. Kill HGs around the tower and a [[tainted hill giant]] will spawn. Kill it and hopefully a [[corrupted hill giant]] will spawn. When it dies, loot an [[Ancient Rock]] from it.
(This turn in requires 46+) Give the 3 items looted from all the Corrupted monsters to the Withered Treant in NK to receive the [[Warm Pulsing Treant Heart]].

Go to [[Yeka Ias]] (2330, -2340) in South Karana, who is far to the east of the bridge and along the water, and give him the heart. He will give you the Cleansed Spirit of Antonica. This is the easiest of the three spirits.

You will meet a [[Pained Unicorn]] in [[Lesser Faydark]]. He is on either Faydark Champions or Soldiers of Tunare faction (probably Soldiers, as it is the druid faction. It is one of the factions raised by the [[Muffin for Pandos]] quest).

The second creature is the [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]]. You need 3-4 high level people to take this one out. It spawns on an island west of Sister Island in OOT. Take the boat from Freeport, get off on Sister Island, and head west. The first island is the one with a mage spell vendor in a tower.

The next island to the west is Sea Fury island. There's around a half dozen Sea Furies (cyclops). You can pull them to the shore or other island until a Tainted spawns. The best tactic is fear kiting because they hit hard and are around level 52. The [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] also summons. The item dropped is Seavines.

Now head back to the Unicorn. The Unicorn will give you a gleaming horn for the 3 items looted from the corrupted. This has to be handed to the gnome Silox Azrix in Ak'Anon to get the Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer. He is near the mines on the left side of the green river. There is another green gnome near him but you can do this part with superior camouflage on you if you are KoS or otherwise disliked there because you need no faction for Silox.

[[Ulump Pujluk]], a named Froglok in [[Swamp of No Hope]] tells you to give his own essence along with the 3 corrupted things to the gnome that hurts the land. His location is -108, -1762. He is around level 55+ and hits for over 200 damage with 32000 hitpoints and almost 100% magic resist. The only spell that works is the wizard Lure spell. You should have 2 groups with 4-6 melees and 2-4 healers to kill Ulump (was able to take him down with 2 lvl57 monks fully buffed and a cleric), casters with pets if you can, and damage shield the tanks. He drops the Froglok Essence.

The last, final and toughest mob in this whole ordeal is the dragon [[Faydedar]] in Timorous Deep. He's a really small for a dragon and looks like a lowland basilisk in Butcherblock, but don't be fooled. He is at least level 53 and hits rapidly for up to 250 damage and has major magic resist.

When you go to trigger him, have the casters hiding in the second tunnel that leads into the oasis. This will keep them out of range of the AoEs and Dragon Roar. Take the tanks with you to the shore where you will see a dwarf fisherman named [[Dolgin Codslayer]]. Give him the Froglok Essence you got from Ulump. Dolgin will give it back to you and depop (he has a 12 hour respawn). This triggers Fay. Have the tanks melee him down to 80 or 70 percent, then bring in the casters from the tunnel to nuke him and start healing the tanks. His magic resists are very high, but cold spells and wizard lures can stick, as will Tashan. But to be honest, lots of tanks and lots of clerics really are the tactic here. Casters won't be much help except wizards for lures and enchanters to haste the tanks.

The tactics are: load up with about four or five useless, dummy buffs like see invisible, save vs. poison, etc. Then put on your good buffs. He will dispel you several times, so let the garbage buffs go first. You need as high fire and magic resist as possible, those are his main weapons. Get all the fire and magic resist gear you can and have a bard to twist Psalm of Mystic Shielding and Psalm of Cooling. Also, remove SoW and turn run to walk. He will fear people. If you are SoWed and running you will go quite a distance. Never, under any circumstances, should a caster sit to med when they go OOM. You will be summoned and killed. Last, never heal yourself. Have someone else do it.
Kill him and loot the [[Pod of Seawater]].

Hand the 4 items to the Gnome Nekexin Virulence in Overthere. He is by the water at the far north end of the zone, to the east of the evil outpost. Approach from the far east, heading west. The evil outpost, with those damned goons, is on the far west of the zone by the water and you don't want to go near it. Give him the Froglok Essence, Pure Lakewater, Green Tree Bark and Pod of Seawater. He will depop and give you the Cleansed Spirit of Kunark. (His respawn time after depop is 2 hours).
Hand the 3 'Cleansed Spirits' and the scimitar to [[Xanuusus]] the Treant in North Karana.
Congratulations on your {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}}!
Telin Darkforest may be found at 3240, 2862, -155 in [[Burning Woods]].
: Telin Darkforest considers you for a few moments before speaking. 'A great evil walks across the land. The hand of some demon we don't yet know is twisting and polluting forests.'

: Telin Darkforest looks at you and sighs. 'The lands are changing. Beasts, large and small, have turned upon those who watched over them. Druids and rangers, worshippers of both Karana and Tunare, have reported a feeling of hatred throughout their once peaceful lands.'
If your faction standing is too low with Faydarks Champions (high amiable required), you can build it up by doing the [[Muffin for Pandos]] quest in Freeport.

: Telin Darkforest looks at you consideringly and then scribbles something quickly on a small, worn paper. 'You seem powerful enough. Perhaps you can help those who seek to protect nature's peace. Take this note. Deliver it only into the hands of Faelin Bloodbriar. Where you will find her, I cannot say. She is a friend of mine and a wanderer. She has been seen from one end of the lands to the other. Seek her out, and quickly.'
You receive a Worn Note (identifies as "Note from the hands of Telin").
Find Faelin Bloodbriar in the [[Greater Faydark]], a rare spawn at +1500, +500, with an orc pawn as placeholder. She roams the northern part of the zone near Crushbone. Give her the note.
You receive Faelin's Ring (identifies as "Personal Ring of Faelin"). Faelin despawns.
Find Giz X`Tin roaming the path in [[Kithicor Forest]], but he may be found at +1501, +940. Give him the ring.
You receive a Dark Metal Coin (identifies as "An old coin"). A level 50 Teir`Dal Reaver spawns and attacks. You can outrun it with SoW if required, or kill it (no faction hits). Once it's dead:
You get a Worn Dark Metal Coin back (identifies as "An old coin, worn through handling"). Althele may be found in East Karana at -3650, -1600.
You receive a Braided Grass Amulet (identifies as "Token of Gathering").
* Your faction standing with [[Indigo Brotherhood]] got worse.
* Your faction standing with [[Emerald Warriors]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Steel Warriors]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Primordial Malice]] got better.
{{YouGainExperience}}

: Althele hands the book to Tholris who reads through it with lines of concern etched on his face, then whispers into her ear. 'Dire news, indeed. This cannot be allowed. I must keep this book but you, ______, must not allow Innoruuk, to seed the land with his hatred and filth. You have only just begun your quest. The path you are guided upon will be difficult, if not impossible, but someone must finish it. Please, take this, read of it, follow its instructions. Tunare bless your path and Karana watch over you.'
You receive an Earth Stained Note (identifies as "Note from Althele"), which reads:
In case this note were to fall into others' hands, I cannot tell you plainly the next steps of your task.

Give her this note and she will know. Althele then despawns for one hour so if you are doing multiple druid fights, make sure everyone gets their corrupter kills in before anyone turns in their book to Althele.
You receive a Shiny Tin Bowl.
# [[Chilled Tundra Root]] from Everfrost Peaks (identifies as "Root frozen rock hard by the tundra")
# [[Sweetened Mudroot]] from Misty Thicket (identifies as "Sweet Root from Misty Thicket")
# [[Speckled Molded Mushroom]] from Innothule Swamp (identifies as "Old molded mushroom")
# [[Ripened Heartfruit]] from Greater Faydark (identifies as "Fruit ripened perfectly")

: Alrik Farsight rummages through his tattered bag and throws aside a towel. 'Too many towels. Oh well, someone told me they were good to have once. Here it is, a bowl pattern. Interesting bowl. Looks almost like a magical bowl but I'm no potter. You need it, you say? Well, it is interesting. Part of my research here is for the wizard guild in Felwithe. I'm sure they'd put a high price on this one, the enchanters guild being so interested in trading for magical paraphernalia and all. Of course if you helped me out on a chore I have, I'd be happy to give it to you. I need to deliver an artifact to the guild and I'd much rather stay here exploring. If you wish, you can take the artifact and return with the receipt and I'll give you the pattern.'

You receive a Crushed Pot (identifies as "Ancient crushed pot"). Seek out Farios Elianos in Southern Felwithe at +380, -845. If he won't respond to you, you must build up your faction with Keepers of the Art. Give him the pot.
You receive a Grocery List (identifies as "List of Provisions"). Take it to Merchant Nora in Northern Felwithe at +145, -415, inside the Shop of All Holos.
You receive a Bag of Provisions (identifies as "Bag of Groceries"). Bring it back to Farios.
You receive a Receipt (identifies as "Receipt for errand running"). Bring it back to Alrik.
If you did the previous turn-in close enough to Xiblin Fizzlebik, you'll see:
You receive an [[Ancient Pattern]] (identifies as "Ancient Bowl Pattern"). It reads:
To obtain [[Enchanted Clay]], seek out Kinlo Strongarm in Kaladim's Everhot Forge in North Kaladim at +350, -175.
The axe in question is a [[Jade Reaver]], dropped in the [[City of Mist]]. Hand it in:
You receive [[Enchanted Clay]] (identifies as "Dwarven holy clay").
To obtain [[Platinum Speckled Powder]], seek out [[Merdan Fleetfoot]] in [[Surefall Glade]] at +245, -75.
Forage a [[Rose of Firiona]] in [[Firiona Vie]] and bring it back to him.

You receive a [[Wood Painting]] (identifies as "Painting for Niera"). Find "a human skeleton" wandering the western side of the Frontier Mountains from the giant fort to the Burning Woods zoneline near -815, -905, on the south side of the giant fort. Give it the painting.
You receive Platinum Speckled Powder.
Now combine the pattern, clay and powder in any pottery wheel to make the [[Runecrested Bowl]] (identifies as "A meticulously decorated bowl").
You receive a [[Softly glowing stone]] (identifies as "Left Half of Natures Balance").
Kill [[Venril Sathir]] and loot the [[Pulsing Green Stone]].

Venril Sathirs remains grasps the glowing sphere of fireflies from your hands. Tendrils of mystical energy begin to flow forth from the swarm of glowing insects like tiny fingers. The glowing tendrils begin to reach into the ribcage of the rotting remains of Venril Sathir, coalescing into the form of an iksar ghost.
Head back to Foloal and give her the [[Softly glowing stone]] and Pulsing Green Stone.
You get a [[Warmly Glowing Stone]] (identifies as "Nature's Balance Completed").

: Ella Foodcrafter hands you a scimitar she usually wears at her side. 'Thank you, ______. With this we can hold back the corruption. We have learned something new though. Not only is this work the responsibility of the lord of hatred alone. For some reason we cannot know the lord of disease has decided it worthy of his time to work in conjunction with Innoruuk. The spirits of the three main continents, Faydwer, Antonica, and Kunark, have been corrupted. Look for the corrupted forces of the land and heal them. When you have found them all then take my scimitar and the spirits to Xanuusus.'
You receive an Elaborate Scimitar (identifies as "Elaborately Runed Scimitar").

To spawn the corrupted brownie, kill brownie scouts near 0, 0 to spawn the tainted brownie, which you must kill to spawn the corrupted version. Kill that to loot a [[Green Heartwood Branch]] (identifies as "Green Branch from a Heartwood Tree").

To spawn the corrupted seafury cyclops, kill seafury cyclops until you spawn a tainted seafury cyclops, which you must kill to spawn the corrupted version. Kill that to loot [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]] (identifies as "Sea Vines from Ocean of Tears").

To spawn the corrupted seahorse, kill seahorses until you spawn a tainted seahorse (found at 152.04, -401.71, -72.79), which you must kill to spawn the corrupted version. Kill that to loot [[Kedge Cave Crystals]] (identifies as "Pure Crystals from Kedge").
You receive a Gleaming Unicorn Horn (identifies as "Pure Symbol of Tunare").

: Silox Azrix looks up at you with a twisted gleam in his eyes. 'Something for me then, eh?' As he looks closer his skin begins to peel and stretch, a bright hot light emanating from his hands gripped around the unicorn horn. 'NOOOO!' The pure cleansing light burns away the gnome without a trace of his existence except for a tiny ball of light which you pick up.
You receive the Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer.
Find a [[withered treant]] in North Karana at +1175, -1050.

To spawn the [[corrupted hill giant]], kill hill giants south of the hill with the guard tower until you spawn the [[tainted hill giant]], which you must kill to spawn the corrupted hill giant. Kill it to loot an [[Ancient Rock]] (identifies as "Ancient piece of earth from Rathe Mountains").
You receive a [[Warm Pulsing Treant Heart]] (identifies as "Pure Symbol of Karana"). The treant despawns.
Find [[Yeka Ias]] in South Karana at 2330, -2355. Occasionally he emotes:

: Yeka Ias grabs the heart as you toss it to him before realizing what it is. As soon as it touches his hands, his body convulses, a sickly light emanating from his eyes and oozing cracks appear in his skin. As he melts into the ground, a small glowing ball floats where he once stood.
You receive the Cleansed Spirit of Antonica. It despawns.
Find [[Ulump Pujluk]], a named froglok in the [[Swamp of No Hope]] at -110, -1760.
Finally, find [[Faydedar]] up and kill him to loot the [[Pod of Seawater]] (identifies as "Seawater from Timorous").
The triggered version of Faydedar spawns in the hidden oasis in Timorous Deep. To spawn it, find [[Dolgin Codslayer]] at -11840, -1855, on the beach in the oasis. Map location:

: Dolgin Codslayer says 'Aye lad. I seen it come from the ocean. It was fightin' a group of adventurers, not unlike yerself. The battle raged long and hard, and at the end the beast lay still among countless of the adventurers bodies. They left assuming it had been slain by their hands. But, once they left, I seen it come crawlin in this here place. They called it by the name Fayde, er, Fayred. Hrmm. What was it they called it? I can't remember.'
Hand him the froglok essence looted from Ulump.
He will hand it back and despawn. Faydedar will now be spawned in the water in the middle of the oasis. Kill it to loot a Pod of Seawater (identifies as "Seawater from Timorous").

Give the four items to Nekexin (Ulump Pujluk told you to hand his "essence and the three foci from the corrupted beasts to the filthy gnome who hurts the land. Ulump can feel him, far off near the large water.").
It despawns. You receive the Cleansed Spirit of Kunark.

: Xanuusus pushes the spirits into the air, making them dance around the scimitar. With a wave of his hand they melt into the blade and hilt of the weapon. 'With this the spirits of the lands are now free from the corruption of the dark gods. Through your strength and dedication was this possible, ______. May the foul poison that once poured into the earth itself never do so again. Take this weapon that you may continue to watch over the balance of nature. Go now, with the gods' blessings.'
You gain experience!!
You receive your epic weapon, the {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}}.

== Rewards ==
<ul><li> {{:Elaborate Scimitar}}
• {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}}
** The [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] summons and so is (nearly?) impossible for a [[Druid]] to solo.  Bring a [[Necromancer]] friend, as he is easy to fear kite.
** The [[Corrupted Seahorse]] summons and so is very difficult for a [[Druid]] to solo. Bring (at least) a [[Torpor]] [[Shaman]] or small group.
** The  [[Corrupted Brownie]] summons and so is difficult for a [[Druid]] to solo.
* Must kill [[a black reaver]] (or buy a [[Jade Reaver]])
* Must kill [[Venril Sathir]] (the version spawned by [[Venril Sathirs remains]]), which requires a small raid, or buy a multi-quested [[Pulsing Green Stone]]
* Must kill [[Ulump Pujluk]] (requires a small group)
* Must kill [[Faydedar]]
* '''Acquire a [[Shiny Tin Bowl]]''' ( '''Warning : You must be ready to face Dark Elfs, by starting East Karana part, Nuien trigger Teloa, who trigger Dark Elfs''' )
:* Speak with [[Telin Darkforest]] in [[Burning Wood]] and say "I will take action" to receive a [[Worn note]].
:* Spawn [[Faelin Bloodbriar]] in [[Greater Faydark]] and give her the Worn Note to receive [[Faelin`s Ring]].
:* Give [[Giz X`Tin]] in [[Kithicor Forest]] Faelin`s Ring to receive a [[Dark Metal Coin]].
:* Give [[Telin Darkforest]] in [[Burning Wood]] the Dark Metal Coin to receive [[Worn Dark Metal Coin]].
:* Give [[Althele]] in [[East Karana]] the Worn Dark Metal Coin to receive [[Braided Grass Amulet]].
:* Give [[Sionae]] (-2300, -930 in [[East Karana]]) the Braided Grass Amulet. (Amulet is returned)
:* Give [[Nuien]] (-3650, 300 in [[East Karana]]) the Braided Grass Amulet. (Amulet is returned)

:* '''CAUTION, THIS STEP SPAWNS AN ENEMY YOU MUST INTERCEPT''': Give [[Teloa]] (-3800, -2860 in [[East Karana]]) the Braided Grass Amulet, spawning the [[Dark Elf Corruptor]] and two [[Dark Elf Reaver]] at (-700, -1450) '''Note: They run really fast when spawned, almost SoW fast'''
:* Kill the [[Dark Elf Corruptor]], loot [[Fleshbound Tome]].
:* Give [[Althele]] in [[East Karana]] the Fleshbound Tome to receive [[Earth Stained Note]].
:* Give [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]] the Earth Stained Note to receive a [[Shiny Tin Bowl]].
* '''Forage the [[Hardened Mixture]]'''
::* [[Chilled Tundra Root]] from [[Everfrost]].
::* [[Ripened Heartfruit]] from [[Greater Faydark]].
::* [[Speckled Molded Mushroom]] from [[Innothule Swamp]].
::* [[Sweetened Mudroot]] from [[Misty Thicket]].
:* Combine all four items in the [[Shiny Tin Bowl]] to make a [[Hardened Mixture]].
* '''Make a [[Runecrested Bowl]]'''
:* Acquire an [[Ancient Pattern]]
::* Speak with [[Alrik Farsight]] in [[Timorous Deep]] and say "I will take the artifact" to receive a [[Crushed Pot]].
::* Give [[Farios Elianos]] in [[Felwithe]] South the Crushed Pot to receive a [[Grocery List]].
::* Give [[Merchant Nora]] in [[Northern Felwithe]] the Grocery List to receive a [[Bag of Provisions]].
::* Give [[Farios Elianos]] the Bag of Provisions to receive a [[Receipt]].
::* Give [[Alrik Farsight]] in [[Timorous Deep]] the Receipt to receive an [[Ancient Pattern]].
:* Acquire some [[Platinum Speckled Powder]]
::* Forage a [[Rose of Firiona]] from [[Firiona Vie]].
::* Hail [[Merdan Fleetfoot]] in [[Surefall Glade]], ask him "Who is Niera?", then hand him the Rose of Firiona to receive a [[Wood Painting]].
::* Give [[a human skeleton]] in [[Frontier Mountains]] (behind the giant fort) the Wood Painting to receive a [[Silver Chained Locket]].
::* Give [[Niera Farbreeze]] in [[Surefall Glade]] the Silver Chained Locket to receive [[Platinum Speckled Powder]].
:* Acquire some [[Enchanted Clay]]
::* Kill [[a black reaver]] in [[City of Mist]], loot a [[Jade Reaver]].
::* Give [[Kinlo Strongarm]] in North Kaladim the Jade Reaver to receive [[Enchanted Clay]].
:* Combine the [[Ancient Pattern]], [[Platinum Speckled Powder]], and [[Enchanted Clay]] in a [[Pottery Wheel]] to create a [[Runecrested Bowl]].
* '''Trade Stones for an [[Elaborate Scimitar]]'''
:* Give the [[Hardened Mixture]] and [[Runecrested Bowl]] to [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]] to receive a [[Softly Glowing Stone]].
:* Create a [[Summoned: Firefly Globe]] (level 1 Druid spell, NO RENT, only castable at night: 7p - 4a).
:* Purchase Scroll of [[Resurrection]] (level 49 Cleric spell).
:* Give [[Venril Sathir Remains]] in [[Karnor's Castle]] the Summoned: Firefly Globe to spawn [[Spirit of Venril Sathir]].
:* Give [[Spirit of Venril Sathir]] in [[Karnor's Castle]] the Spell: Resurrection to spawn [[Venril Sathir]].
:* Slay [[Venril Sathir]] in Karnor's Castle and loot a [[Pulsing Green Stone]].
:* Give [[Foloal Stormforest]] in [[Firiona Vie]] the Pulsing Green Stone and Softly Glowing Stone to receive a [[Warmly Glowing Stone]].
:* Give [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]] the Warmly Glowing Stone to receive an [[Elaborate Scimitar]].
::* Kill [[corrupted wooly mammoth]] (level 30) in [[Everfrost Peaks]], loot a [[Chunk of Tundra]].
::* Kill [[corrupted shaman]] (level 40) in [[Lake Rathetear]], loot [[Clean Lakewater]].
::* Kill [[corrupted hill giant]] (level 40) in [[Rathe Mountains]], loot an [[Ancient Rock]].
::* Give [[Withered treant]] in [[Northern Karana]] the [[Chunk of Tundra]], [[Clean Lakewater]] and [[Ancient Rock]] to receive a [[Warm Pulsing Treant Heart]].
::* Give [[Yeka Ias]] in [[Southern Karana]] the Warm Pulsing Treant Heart to receive [[Cleansed Spirit of Antonica]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted Seahorse]] (level 53) in [[Kedge Keep]], loot [[Kedge Cave Crystals]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] (level 52) in [[Ocean of Tears]], loot [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted brownie]] (level 51) in [[Lesser Faydark]], loot [[Green Heartwood Branch]].
::* Give [[Pained Unicorn]] in [[Lesser Faydark]] the [[Kedge Cave Crystals]], [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]] and [[Green Heartwood Branch]] to receive [[Gleaming Unicorn Horn]].
::* Give [[Silox Azrix]] in [[Ak'Anon]] the Gleaming Unicorn Horn to receieve the [[Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer]].
::* Kill [[Ulump Pujluk]] (level 55) in [[Swamp of No Hope]], loot [[Froglok Essence]].
::* Kill [[Corrupted Gorilla]] (level 47) in [[Emerald Jungle]], loot [[Green Tree Bark]].
::* Kill the [[Corrupted barracuda]] (level 46) in [[Lake of Ill Omen]] and loot the [[Pure Lakewater]].
::* Give [[Dolgin Codslayer]] in [[Timorous Deep]] the Froglok Essence (he will hand it back and despawn - 14h respawn) to spawn [[Faydedar]].
::* Kill [[Faydedar]] in [[Timorous Deep]], loot [[Pod of Seawater]].
::* Give [[Nekexin Virulence]] in [[The Overthere]] the [[Froglok Essence]], [[Pod of Seawater]], [[Green Tree Bark]] and [[Pure Lakewater]] to receive [[Cleansed Spirit of Kunark]].
* '''Acquire a [[Nature Walkers Scimitar]]!'''
:* Give [[Xanuusus]] in [[North Karana]] the Elaborate Scimitar and three cleansed spirits to receive the '''[[Nature Walkers Scimitar]]'''.

It starts with {{NPC| Telin Darkforest}} (Level 55) in [[Burning Woods]]. He's hidden in a grove of thick trees near to the [[Skyfire]] zone and has been spotted at 3234, 2871. Use tracking to find him, and invis to get through the zone unharmed. Hail him.
==== Faction Issues ====

If Telin responds with "I can not trust you with such important information yet," changing into wolf form may raise your faction enough to start the quest. If he will not respond even with wolf form, you will need to work on your faction.  Specifically, if you have done any of the following:

Then you will most likely have faction issues to correct in order to complete the epic. Also, if you are a halfling or human worshipping Karana you may also have some faction work to do (no more than 20 stacks of Muffins, see below).

It's tedious, but it can be done.   ''As of 2017-07-12, I was able to receive the worn note in wolf form without any faction work. (55 Halfling Druid) (I just did the turn in on a 47 Halfling worshipping Karana with no faction work and not in wolf form - 11/28/2017)''

He will give you 'a worn note'. If he doesn't, then your faction may be too low. Faction can be built up fast by doing the "Muffin Quest" ([[Muffin for Pandos]]) in Freeport. Also, you must be of level 50 or higher before he will speak to you as well. [This may not be true - I was able to have him speak to me on my level 46 Woodelf druid. Does NOT work with a level 46 Halfling Druid. **Note: Was able to turn in 18 stacks of Muffins to get to Amiable and Telin gave me 'a worn note' on 46 Halfling Druid of Karana (I just did the turn in on a 47 Halfling worshipping Karana with no faction work and not in wolf form - 11/28/2017)]
*note: As a 47 halfling druid, went from apprehensive to amiable when in wolf form. Received the note. 7/8/22

*note: Level 44 halfing druid (Karana) initially apprehensive and no dialog.  In wolf form, amiable, but got the message "You are not yet powerful enough to complete this task..."  Likely requirements are level 46 and faction.

Next, [[Faelin Bloodbriar]] in [[Greater Faydark]]. She spawns around 1513, 561 or south-west of the [[Crushbone]] zone with a 7 minute respawn. She has an orc pawn placeholder, so kill every pawn you see to make her spawn. Once she spawns, make sure you have casted [[Spirit of the Wolf]] on yourself, because she runs constantly and won't stop when you hail her. Give her the note (and keep running after her) and you'll receive a ring. After giving her the note she despawns.
(While you do this step, make sure to forage; you may get a [[Ripened Heartfruit]] you will need in a later step.)

Go to [[Kithicor Forest]] and track [[Giz X`Tin]], a dark elf who will not attack you. He can be found on the path to [[Highpass Hold]], but is usually closer to the [[West Commons]] zone than [[Highpass Hold]]. Be very careful of the other dark elves in this zone. Give him the ring and he gives you a [[Dark Metal Coin]]. After you hand him the ring a level 50 [[Teir`Dal Reaver]] spawns and attacks you. He has tons of HP, backstabs, and summons; don't try to solo him. Have SoW on you so that you can run away. (4 hour repop on this mob, there is also a possibility that multiple Druids and Rangers can turn in back to back but it seems there is a very short time window to do so, plus the risk of the Teir`Dal Reavers is present with each turn in)

Go back to [[Telin Darkforest]], turn into wolf form if necessary, and give him the Coin. He will not accept the coin at apprehensive - he must be amiable. He will give it back to you as [[Worn Dark Metal Coin]] and tells you to find [[Althele]]. She is in [[East Karana]], just west of the barbarian fishing village, near the shore at -3658, -1593. Once you start this section, you begin a chain of events, so don't do it until you are ready to finish the job.
Give her the [[Worn Dark Metal Coin]] and receive a worn amulet.

Give this amulet to [[Sionae]] (-2300, -930) (She can be standing either on the East or West side of the farm located there, so check both sides), then to [[Nuien]] (-3650, 300 - Spawns near the gnolls, out of tracking range) and finally to [[Teloa]] (-3800, -2860 - Spawns near the waterfall). [[Teloa]] will say to follow her, but don't. Sionae, Nuien and Teloa will each run to join Althele. A [[Dark Elf Corruptor]] and two Darkelf Reavers (all around level 50) will spawn around (-700, -1450) (it will take a minute or two before they spawn after turning in to Teloa, there will be a zone message from the Corruptor when they do).  The trio will run south toward this gathering of druids and be summarily decimated and the corpses will poof.  '''Therefore you or your party must wait for them or intercept them before they get to there. If they poof, you must start from the beginning''' (it is suggested to stand near the farm where Sionae was located and just look north up the mountain to watch for them, invis and them run up next to them when you see them and Harmony off to the side to not aggro, then pull away the Corruptor). Also keep in mind these inkies are Shadow Knights, so don't be too close to their spawn point or you will be harm touched (To solo as a Druid in the 50s, Buff HP, MR, DR, FR, SoW, and Regen and Root Rot after peeling Corruptor away with Harmony).  If you do choose to engage all three, a charmed pet can be useful to absorb harm touches.  Most of the animals in the zone are lower lvl, but they're still useful for something.

If the Reavers kill the druids (which, again, won't happen), just wait one hour of real time (not EQ time) and [[Althele]] will spawn again. Give her the tome and she gives you an [[Earth Stained Note]]. She then despawns for one hour so if you are doing back to back fights for multiple druids, don't turn any books in until you have all got one. Bring the [[Earth Stained Note]] to [[Ella Foodcrafter]], a Halfling running around in [[Misty Thicket]]. Like Faelin, she constantly runs, so you have to chase her. Give her the [[Earth Stained Note]] and she will tell you that she needs a mixture. She will give you her mixing bowl. It is a Container so you need a free slot in the Inventory. She also mentions some kind of ancient bowl that she needs.
* A [[Chilled Tundra Root]] from [[Everfrost Peaks]]
* A [[Sweetened Mudroot]] from [[Misty Thicket]]
* A [[Speckled Molded Mushroom]] from [[Innothule Swamp]]
* A [[Ripened Heartfruit]] from [[Greater Faydark]]

Now go to the Chess Island in [[Timorous Deep]]. Take the Barrel Barge (boat) from the dock in Oasis of Marr , which will take you to Timorous Deep. Cast Egress to transport yourself to the Chess board island, or cast levitate on yourself to make the run. Use track to locate Alrik Farsight. He's at about -6500, 2000, but does wander. Egress is a level 52 Druid spell, and Succor is a level 57 group.

You say, "Hail, Alrik Farsight", "How do you make an ancient bowl?" and "I can take the artifact." He gives you a crushed pot and sends you to Felwithe. You will soon return here but, unfortunately, you can't bind on the island.

You must con amiable to him. If your faction is too low, you can build up faction fast with the "[[Bat Wings|Batwings Quest]]" in Felwithe South. [Please note, Farios Elianos conned kindly to my wood elf druid, but would not speak to her when hailed. This didn't affect the progress of the quest, as I was still able to turn in the crushed pot to receive the grocery list.]

Once Farios cons amiable and talks to you, give him the pot and you receive a grocery list. The dialogue with the NPCs for this segment is pretty funny. He will give you the receipt for the bowl if you do a job for him. Bring this grocery list to [[Merchant Nora]] in the Shop of All Halos in [Felwithe North]], which is near the cleric guild. She gives you in return a bag of Provisions. Bring it to Farios and he gives you the receipt for the ancient bowl. Head back to [[Alrik Farsight]] in [[Timorous Deep]]. He will give you an [[Ancient Pattern]] when you give him the receipt.
The pattern says that you have to combine it with a piece of enchanted clay and [[Platinum Speckled Powder]] in a pottery wheel. No skill in pottery is required.
[[Platinum Speckled Powder]] can be obtained through the following sub quest:

Forage a [[Rose of Firiona]] in [[Firiona Vie]] and give it to [[Merdan Fleetfoot]] in [[Surefall Glade]], a male ranger in the back of the zone, near the water. In return he will give you a [[Wood Painting]]. You may find it beneficial to bind your self in Surefall at this point to save time running back from [[Frontier Mountains]]. The Wood Painting that you get from Merdan has to be brought to the human skeleton (Level 40) lives in [[Frontier Mountains]]. It can be found at (-261, -574) behind the giant fort (along the outside of the fort's West wall).

Gate back to [[Surefall Glade]]. Give the locket to [[Niera Farbreeze]], a human female in banded armor, also near the water but close to the druid guild building. She will hand you the [[platinum speckled powder]].

[[Enchanted Clay]] can be obtained through [[Kinlo Strongarm]] in Kaladim's EverHot Forge. If you ask him "what mud" and "do it for me" he will tell you that he would like to have a colored axe for his service. He wants a [[Jade Reaver]] that can be found in the City of Mist off of [[a black reaver]] who is about level 52. This is not easy at all. The [[Jade Reaver]] is a rare drop and the Black Reavers are a real pain to take down. You will need at least one full group of 50+ players if not two, and one must be a rogue with high lock picking skills.

Hand Kinlo the axe and you get the enchanted clay. If you hunted dwarf citizens in Butcher, invis yourself and head to the forge. You are able to do a sneak turn-in from behind if Kinlo himself is KOS to you. The merchants, thankfully, are on a different faction table. Just go to the Everhot Forge and hand Kinlo a [[Jade Reaver]] to get the clay. Now combine the pattern, clay and powder in any pottery wheel to make the [[Runecrested Bowl]].

Go Back to [[Misty Thicket]] and hand [[Ella Foodcrafter]] the [[Hardened Mixture]] and the [[Runecrested Bowl]]. She will make for you a [[Softly glowing stone]] from it. Ella tells you to find one such as yourself. For the Druids this means to seek out [[Foloal Stormforest]] in [[Firiona Vie]].

Foloal is a half elf on the wall that circles the city of [[Firiona Vie]] at the north end. Ask her "are you one such as myself?", "what answers?" and "what about [[Venril Sathir]]?" She tells you to bring her the stone you already have from Ella and the gem that can be found on [[Venril Sathir]]. Kill him to get the [[Pulsing Green Stone]].

You can kill [[Venril Sathir]] in [[Karnor's Castle]], but why? Venril is a very tough shadow knight. He is only killed by the strongest guilds or big raids because he is level 55, hits for 300 FAST, has a 1000+ life suck spell and has three personal clerics that heal him whenever he gets hurt. This guy is extremely hard so you might want to be in a good raid guild to do this part.

Better thing to do is let some uber guild take him down. He gets killed for his loot all the time. His remains will spawn in 24 hours, or less. When you see [[Venril Sathir]] Remains on track, get your friends together, fast. The Remains will be indifferent to you and just stand there. Hail him and he will respond.

First, conjure a Firefly Globe. [[Dance of the Fireflies]] is a level 5 druid spell that you may not have even bought, but you'll need it for this. Hand him the globe. A new VS will spawn. Then give him the level 49 cleric [[Resurrection]] spell, which you can buy at any cleric guild. He will attack you. Step back and let your tanks take him out. Thankfully, this new VS is not as brutal as the original, but he's no cakewalk either.
The remains will drop two stones, called [[Pulsing Green Stone]]. You can use either stone.

Take the [[Softly glowing stone]] and [[Pulsing Green Stone]] to [[Foloal Stormforest]] a female half elf in [[Firiona Vie]]. She will give you a [[Warmly Glowing Stone]]. This is the time where the quest splits up into the Druid and the Ranger parts. Up to now, they've been identical.

The Druid's path leads back to [[Ella Foodcrafter]] in [[Misty Thicket]]. Give her the stone and you will get the [[Elaborate Scimitar]] (10/30 9 wis 10 mana 5 sv poison and disease). Now you have one of the four final pieces and a pretty good weapon in its own right.
She asks you to collect the Cleansed Spirits of Antonica, Faydwer and Kunark and hand them along with the scimitar to Xanuusus.

Go to [[Northern Karana]] and find a [[withered treant]]. It is at the far north end of NK, at the base of a mountain wall. It’s very close to Xanuusus, who gets the three Cleansed Spirits and the Scimitar when you are done. Hail him and ask him "What Sickness" and he will respond that he wants you to cleanse Antonica of its sickness. He means to kill three things.

The second monster is the [[Corrupted Shaman]], an aqua goblin. He is mid level 30 in Lake Rathe with side spawns on tops of the underwater tower. There is a female dark elf named Deep for the Cleric Epic Quest. Ignore her and she’ll ignore you. Do this in wolf form so the other goblins won't agro on you. Some people have chosen to fight under water, but if Enduring Breath wears off you could be in a heap of trouble. You are better off kiting the goblins at the top of the tower to the surface, especially since these gobs are clerics and cast some strong cleric spells. They can dish out a serious hurting, plus they can heal themselves. Kill the gobs at the top of the tower only, don’t bother with the ones around the base. Eventually a [[Tainted Aquagoblin]] will spawn. Kill the Corrupted and get a Clean Lakewater item. It looks like a globe of water. (Note that if you try to use the tower's inner corners to prevent water push back from mob hits to mitigate casting interrupts, the corners will auto-duck you)

The third one creature is the Corrupted Hill Giant in Rathe Mountains. You want to hunt in the HG area south of the hill with the Guard Tower in Rathe, where Cyclops can also be found. The same process applies here. Kill HGs around the tower and a [[tainted hill giant]] will spawn. Kill it and hopefully a [[corrupted hill giant]] will spawn. When it dies, loot an [[Ancient Rock]] from it.
(This turn in requires 46+) Give the 3 items looted from all the Corrupted monsters to the Withered Treant in NK to receive the [[Warm Pulsing Treant Heart]].

Go to [[Yeka Ias]] (2330, -2340) in South Karana, who is far to the east of the bridge and along the water, and give him the heart. He will give you the Cleansed Spirit of Antonica. This is the easiest of the three spirits.

You will meet a [[Pained Unicorn]] in [[Lesser Faydark]]. He is on either Faydark Champions or Soldiers of Tunare faction (probably Soldiers, as it is the druid faction. It is one of the factions raised by the [[Muffin for Pandos]] quest).

The second creature is the [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]]. You need 3-4 high level people to take this one out. It spawns on an island west of Sister Island in OOT. Take the boat from Freeport, get off on Sister Island, and head west. The first island is the one with a mage spell vendor in a tower.

The next island to the west is Sea Fury island. There's around a half dozen Sea Furies (cyclops). You can pull them to the shore or other island until a Tainted spawns. The best tactic is fear kiting because they hit hard and are around level 52. The [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] also summons. The item dropped is Seavines.

Now head back to the Unicorn. The Unicorn will give you a gleaming horn for the 3 items looted from the corrupted. This has to be handed to the gnome Silox Azrix in Ak'Anon to get the Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer. He is near the mines on the left side of the green river. There is another green gnome near him but you can do this part with superior camouflage on you if you are KoS or otherwise disliked there because you need no faction for Silox.

[[Ulump Pujluk]], a named Froglok in [[Swamp of No Hope]] tells you to give his own essence along with the 3 corrupted things to the gnome that hurts the land. His location is -108, -1762. He is around level 55+ and hits for over 200 damage with 32000 hitpoints and almost 100% magic resist. The only spell that works is the wizard Lure spell. You should have 2 groups with 4-6 melees and 2-4 healers to kill Ulump (was able to take him down with 2 lvl57 monks fully buffed and a cleric), casters with pets if you can, and damage shield the tanks. He drops the Froglok Essence.

The last, final and toughest mob in this whole ordeal is the dragon [[Faydedar]] in Timorous Deep. He's a really small for a dragon and looks like a lowland basilisk in Butcherblock, but don't be fooled. He is at least level 53 and hits rapidly for up to 250 damage and has major magic resist.

When you go to trigger him, have the casters hiding in the second tunnel that leads into the oasis. This will keep them out of range of the AoEs and Dragon Roar. Take the tanks with you to the shore where you will see a dwarf fisherman named [[Dolgin Codslayer]]. Give him the Froglok Essence you got from Ulump. Dolgin will give it back to you and depop (he has a 12 hour respawn). This triggers Fay. Have the tanks melee him down to 80 or 70 percent, then bring in the casters from the tunnel to nuke him and start healing the tanks. His magic resists are very high, but cold spells and wizard lures can stick, as will Tashan. But to be honest, lots of tanks and lots of clerics really are the tactic here. Casters won't be much help except wizards for lures and enchanters to haste the tanks.

The tactics are: load up with about four or five useless, dummy buffs like see invisible, save vs. poison, etc. Then put on your good buffs. He will dispel you several times, so let the garbage buffs go first. You need as high fire and magic resist as possible, those are his main weapons. Get all the fire and magic resist gear you can and have a bard to twist Psalm of Mystic Shielding and Psalm of Cooling. Also, remove SoW and turn run to walk. He will fear people. If you are SoWed and running you will go quite a distance. Never, under any circumstances, should a caster sit to med when they go OOM. You will be summoned and killed. Last, never heal yourself. Have someone else do it.
Kill him and loot the [[Pod of Seawater]].

Hand the 4 items to the Gnome Nekexin Virulence in Overthere. He is by the water at the far north end of the zone, to the east of the evil outpost. Approach from the far east, heading west. The evil outpost, with those damned goons, is on the far west of the zone by the water and you don't want to go near it. Give him the Froglok Essence, Pure Lakewater, Green Tree Bark and Pod of Seawater. He will depop and give you the Cleansed Spirit of Kunark. (His respawn time after depop is 2 hours).
Hand the 3 'Cleansed Spirits' and the scimitar to [[Xanuusus]] the Treant in North Karana.
Congratulations on your {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}}!
Telin Darkforest may be found at 3240, 2862, -155 in [[Burning Woods]].
: Telin Darkforest considers you for a few moments before speaking. 'A great evil walks across the land. The hand of some demon we don't yet know is twisting and polluting forests.'

: Telin Darkforest looks at you and sighs. 'The lands are changing. Beasts, large and small, have turned upon those who watched over them. Druids and rangers, worshippers of both Karana and Tunare, have reported a feeling of hatred throughout their once peaceful lands.'
If your faction standing is too low with Faydarks Champions (high amiable required), you can build it up by doing the [[Muffin for Pandos]] quest in Freeport.

: Telin Darkforest looks at you consideringly and then scribbles something quickly on a small, worn paper. 'You seem powerful enough. Perhaps you can help those who seek to protect nature's peace. Take this note. Deliver it only into the hands of Faelin Bloodbriar. Where you will find her, I cannot say. She is a friend of mine and a wanderer. She has been seen from one end of the lands to the other. Seek her out, and quickly.'
You receive a Worn Note (identifies as "Note from the hands of Telin").
Find Faelin Bloodbriar in the [[Greater Faydark]], a rare spawn at +1500, +500, with an orc pawn as placeholder. She roams the northern part of the zone near Crushbone. Give her the note.
You receive Faelin's Ring (identifies as "Personal Ring of Faelin"). Faelin despawns.
Find Giz X`Tin roaming the path in [[Kithicor Forest]], but he may be found at +1501, +940. Give him the ring.
You receive a Dark Metal Coin (identifies as "An old coin"). A level 50 Teir`Dal Reaver spawns and attacks. You can outrun it with SoW if required, or kill it (no faction hits). Once it's dead:
You get a Worn Dark Metal Coin back (identifies as "An old coin, worn through handling"). Althele may be found in East Karana at -3650, -1600.
You receive a Braided Grass Amulet (identifies as "Token of Gathering").
* Your faction standing with [[Indigo Brotherhood]] got worse.
* Your faction standing with [[Emerald Warriors]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Steel Warriors]] got better.
* Your faction standing with [[Primordial Malice]] got better.
{{YouGainExperience}}

: Althele hands the book to Tholris who reads through it with lines of concern etched on his face, then whispers into her ear. 'Dire news, indeed. This cannot be allowed. I must keep this book but you, ______, must not allow Innoruuk, to seed the land with his hatred and filth. You have only just begun your quest. The path you are guided upon will be difficult, if not impossible, but someone must finish it. Please, take this, read of it, follow its instructions. Tunare bless your path and Karana watch over you.'
You receive an Earth Stained Note (identifies as "Note from Althele"), which reads:
In case this note were to fall into others' hands, I cannot tell you plainly the next steps of your task.

Give her this note and she will know. Althele then despawns for one hour so if you are doing multiple druid fights, make sure everyone gets their corrupter kills in before anyone turns in their book to Althele.
You receive a Shiny Tin Bowl.
# [[Chilled Tundra Root]] from Everfrost Peaks (identifies as "Root frozen rock hard by the tundra")
# [[Sweetened Mudroot]] from Misty Thicket (identifies as "Sweet Root from Misty Thicket")
# [[Speckled Molded Mushroom]] from Innothule Swamp (identifies as "Old molded mushroom")
# [[Ripened Heartfruit]] from Greater Faydark (identifies as "Fruit ripened perfectly")

: Alrik Farsight rummages through his tattered bag and throws aside a towel. 'Too many towels. Oh well, someone told me they were good to have once. Here it is, a bowl pattern. Interesting bowl. Looks almost like a magical bowl but I'm no potter. You need it, you say? Well, it is interesting. Part of my research here is for the wizard guild in Felwithe. I'm sure they'd put a high price on this one, the enchanters guild being so interested in trading for magical paraphernalia and all. Of course if you helped me out on a chore I have, I'd be happy to give it to you. I need to deliver an artifact to the guild and I'd much rather stay here exploring. If you wish, you can take the artifact and return with the receipt and I'll give you the pattern.'

You receive a Crushed Pot (identifies as "Ancient crushed pot"). Seek out Farios Elianos in Southern Felwithe at +380, -845. If he won't respond to you, you must build up your faction with Keepers of the Art. Give him the pot.
You receive a Grocery List (identifies as "List of Provisions"). Take it to Merchant Nora in Northern Felwithe at +145, -415, inside the Shop of All Holos.
You receive a Bag of Provisions (identifies as "Bag of Groceries"). Bring it back to Farios.
You receive a Receipt (identifies as "Receipt for errand running"). Bring it back to Alrik.
If you did the previous turn-in close enough to Xiblin Fizzlebik, you'll see:
You receive an [[Ancient Pattern]] (identifies as "Ancient Bowl Pattern"). It reads:
To obtain [[Enchanted Clay]], seek out Kinlo Strongarm in Kaladim's Everhot Forge in North Kaladim at +350, -175.
The axe in question is a [[Jade Reaver]], dropped in the [[City of Mist]]. Hand it in:
You receive [[Enchanted Clay]] (identifies as "Dwarven holy clay").
To obtain [[Platinum Speckled Powder]], seek out [[Merdan Fleetfoot]] in [[Surefall Glade]] at +245, -75.
Forage a [[Rose of Firiona]] in [[Firiona Vie]] and bring it back to him.

You receive a [[Wood Painting]] (identifies as "Painting for Niera"). Find "a human skeleton" wandering the western side of the Frontier Mountains from the giant fort to the Burning Woods zoneline near -815, -905, on the south side of the giant fort. Give it the painting.
You receive Platinum Speckled Powder.
Now combine the pattern, clay and powder in any pottery wheel to make the [[Runecrested Bowl]] (identifies as "A meticulously decorated bowl").
You receive a [[Softly glowing stone]] (identifies as "Left Half of Natures Balance").
Kill [[Venril Sathir]] and loot the [[Pulsing Green Stone]].

Venril Sathirs remains grasps the glowing sphere of fireflies from your hands. Tendrils of mystical energy begin to flow forth from the swarm of glowing insects like tiny fingers. The glowing tendrils begin to reach into the ribcage of the rotting remains of Venril Sathir, coalescing into the form of an iksar ghost.
Head back to Foloal and give her the [[Softly glowing stone]] and Pulsing Green Stone.
You get a [[Warmly Glowing Stone]] (identifies as "Nature's Balance Completed").

: Ella Foodcrafter hands you a scimitar she usually wears at her side. 'Thank you, ______. With this we can hold back the corruption. We have learned something new though. Not only is this work the responsibility of the lord of hatred alone. For some reason we cannot know the lord of disease has decided it worthy of his time to work in conjunction with Innoruuk. The spirits of the three main continents, Faydwer, Antonica, and Kunark, have been corrupted. Look for the corrupted forces of the land and heal them. When you have found them all then take my scimitar and the spirits to Xanuusus.'
You receive an Elaborate Scimitar (identifies as "Elaborately Runed Scimitar").

To spawn the corrupted brownie, kill brownie scouts near 0, 0 to spawn the tainted brownie, which you must kill to spawn the corrupted version. Kill that to loot a [[Green Heartwood Branch]] (identifies as "Green Branch from a Heartwood Tree").

To spawn the corrupted seafury cyclops, kill seafury cyclops until you spawn a tainted seafury cyclops, which you must kill to spawn the corrupted version. Kill that to loot [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]] (identifies as "Sea Vines from Ocean of Tears").

To spawn the corrupted seahorse, kill seahorses until you spawn a tainted seahorse (found at 152.04, -401.71, -72.79), which you must kill to spawn the corrupted version. Kill that to loot [[Kedge Cave Crystals]] (identifies as "Pure Crystals from Kedge").
You receive a Gleaming Unicorn Horn (identifies as "Pure Symbol of Tunare").

: Silox Azrix looks up at you with a twisted gleam in his eyes. 'Something for me then, eh?' As he looks closer his skin begins to peel and stretch, a bright hot light emanating from his hands gripped around the unicorn horn. 'NOOOO!' The pure cleansing light burns away the gnome without a trace of his existence except for a tiny ball of light which you pick up.
You receive the Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer.
Find a [[withered treant]] in North Karana at +1175, -1050.

To spawn the [[corrupted hill giant]], kill hill giants south of the hill with the guard tower until you spawn the [[tainted hill giant]], which you must kill to spawn the corrupted hill giant. Kill it to loot an [[Ancient Rock]] (identifies as "Ancient piece of earth from Rathe Mountains").
You receive a [[Warm Pulsing Treant Heart]] (identifies as "Pure Symbol of Karana"). The treant despawns.
Find [[Yeka Ias]] in South Karana at 2330, -2355. Occasionally he emotes:

: Yeka Ias grabs the heart as you toss it to him before realizing what it is. As soon as it touches his hands, his body convulses, a sickly light emanating from his eyes and oozing cracks appear in his skin. As he melts into the ground, a small glowing ball floats where he once stood.
You receive the Cleansed Spirit of Antonica. It despawns.
Find [[Ulump Pujluk]], a named froglok in the [[Swamp of No Hope]] at -110, -1760.
Finally, find [[Faydedar]] up and kill him to loot the [[Pod of Seawater]] (identifies as "Seawater from Timorous").
The triggered version of Faydedar spawns in the hidden oasis in Timorous Deep. To spawn it, find [[Dolgin Codslayer]] at -11840, -1855, on the beach in the oasis. Map location:

: Dolgin Codslayer says 'Aye lad. I seen it come from the ocean. It was fightin' a group of adventurers, not unlike yerself. The battle raged long and hard, and at the end the beast lay still among countless of the adventurers bodies. They left assuming it had been slain by their hands. But, once they left, I seen it come crawlin in this here place. They called it by the name Fayde, er, Fayred. Hrmm. What was it they called it? I can't remember.'
Hand him the froglok essence looted from Ulump.
He will hand it back and despawn. Faydedar will now be spawned in the water in the middle of the oasis. Kill it to loot a Pod of Seawater (identifies as "Seawater from Timorous").

Give the four items to Nekexin (Ulump Pujluk told you to hand his "essence and the three foci from the corrupted beasts to the filthy gnome who hurts the land. Ulump can feel him, far off near the large water.").
It despawns. You receive the Cleansed Spirit of Kunark.

: Xanuusus pushes the spirits into the air, making them dance around the scimitar. With a wave of his hand they melt into the blade and hilt of the weapon. 'With this the spirits of the lands are now free from the corruption of the dark gods. Through your strength and dedication was this possible, ______. May the foul poison that once poured into the earth itself never do so again. Take this weapon that you may continue to watch over the balance of nature. Go now, with the gods' blessings.'
You gain experience!!
You receive your epic weapon, the {{:Nature Walkers Scimitar}}.
